containerOverrides.name: chat-api
command: const { PrismaClient } = require('@prisma/client'); const prisma = new PrismaClient(); const isSafe=(n)=>/^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$/.test(n); (async()=>{ const tables = await prisma.$queryRaw`SELECT tablename FROM pg_tables WHERE schemaname='public' ORDER BY tablename`; console.log('Tables in public schema:', tables.map(t=>t.tablename).join(', ')); for (const t of tables){ const name=t.tablename; if(!isSafe(name)){ console.log('SKIP unsafe table name:', name); continue; } const countRows = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe(`SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS count FROM "public"."${name}"`); const count = (countRows && countRows[0] && countRows[0].count) ?? null; console.log(`${name}: ${count}`); } await prisma.$disconnect(); })().catch(async(e)=>{ console.error(e); try{ await prisma.$disconnect(); }catch{} process.exit(1); });
